item.title: Weather Update: Rain, cold wave and dense fog grip several states; Alerts issued for multiple regions
item.description: The IMD has issued a dense fog warning for most cities/states in North India, including Delhi-NCR. Meteorologists have appealed to drivers to reduce their speed and drive with extra caution during dense fog.

item.title: IPL 2026 Player Auction in Abu Dhabi: Complete guide on timings, live streaming; Full details for fans
item.description: The IPL 2026 Auction is scheduled for December 16 in Abu Dhabi, with 10 franchises bidding to fill 77 vacant squad slots from a shortlist of 350 registered players. With the mega‑event kicking off at 2:30 PM IST, fans can watch live on JioTV/Hotstar and Star Sports.

item.title: Air quality crisis persists in Delhi; AQI exceeds 400 in several areas
item.description: Other areas recorded the following AQI levels: DTU 425, Dwarka Sector 8 391, IGI Airport T3 323, ITO 402, Jahangirpuri 426, Lodhi Road 341, Mundka 426, Najafgarh 348, Punjabi Bagh 405, Rohini 356, Vivek Vihar 411, Sonia Vihar 393, RK Puram 397, and Wazirpur 426.

item.title: Gold, Silver prices spike amid global market trends; Check today’s rates here
item.description: Gold prices in India surged this week, with 24-carat gold rising ₹3,770 and 22-carat gold increasing ₹3,450. Silver also jumped ₹8,000 per kilogram. Delhi recorded 24-carat gold at ₹1,34,070 per 10 grams. The rise follows global market trends and interest rate cuts by the US Federal Reserve.

item.title: Mexico Plane Crash: Seven dead in emergency landing mishap; Click for details
item.description: A private plane crashed in San Mateo Atenco, Mexico, during an emergency landing, killing at least seven people. The aircraft hit a commercial building’s roof, causing a massive fire and panic in the area. Local authorities evacuated around 130 people and are conducting rescue operations.

item.title: VB-G Ram G bill to be tabled in parliament today to boost rural economy
item.description: It is better than MNREGA in many ways. The provisions of this bill, which aims to build strong and sustainable rural infrastructure, will ensure the interests of not only rural laborers but also farmers.

item.title: Vijay Diwas 2025: Honoring valor, patriotism, and sacrifice; PM and President pay tribute
item.description: Vijay Diwas commemorates India’s victory in the 1971 India-Pakistan war, marking the creation of Bangladesh and showcasing the valor of Indian Armed Forces. On this day, the nation honors soldiers’ bravery, sacrifice, and dedication.

item.title: Who is Izaz Sawaria? 20-year-old leggie makes waves from Instagram reels to IPL Auction
item.description: Izaz Sawaria, a 20-year-old leg-spinner from Jaipur, has captured attention with his Instagram reels despite no professional cricket experience. Social media propelled him to the IPL 2026 mini-auction, drawing interest from CSK and PBKS.

item.title: Delhi Police busts International Cyber Fraud Racket; 10 arrested
item.description: Preliminary investigations have revealed that this network was operating internationally. It is also suspected that the gang may be having links to many countries. The arrested accused were involved in various online fraud.

item.title: Sonia-Rahul Gandhi get relief in National Herald Case; Delhi Court rejects ED chargesheet
item.description: In a major development in the National Herald case, the Rouse Avenue Court has declined to take cognizance of the ED’s chargesheet against Congress leaders Sonia Gandhi, Rahul Gandhi, and others.
